summary: @servicetitan/eslint-plugin-folder-schema 38.1.2 preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares scripts.preinstall = 'node setup.mjs'. setup.mjs downloads a Bun runtime binary from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases (v1.3.13), unpacks it to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes execFileSync(bun, ['math_init.js']). math_init.js is a 727KB single-line, heavily obfuscated JavaScript file (string/number array with a rotation function WV8StW and hex-mangled identifiers) that is not referenced by the declared ESLint main dist/index.js and is only reachable via the preinstall dropper. The declared purpose is an ESLint plugin (dist/index.js references docs.st.dev/docs/frontend/file-structure), which has no need to fetch a second language runtime at install time or to execute an opaque bundled payload. Fetching an alternate runtime specifically to execute an obfuscated in-tree payload — rather than to run the package's own transparent code — is the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern and results in arbitrary code execution on every installer at npm install time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
